definitions.explanation: A mythical creature from Japanese folklore typically depicted with a long nose or a bird-like beak, often wearing the garb of a mountain priest (yamabushi). Associated with mountains and forests, they are skilled in martial arts and magic.
A person who is arrogant, boastful, or full of themselves. Derived from the tengu's association with pride.

examples.english: Tengu are supernatural creatures that live in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {天狗|てんぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶって→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in the festival wearing a tengu mask.

examples.japanese: {鞍馬山|くらまやま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天狗|てんぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Mt. Kurama is famous for its tengu legends.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{天狗|てんぐ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧な⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Don't get too full of yourself.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦って→って：29146_tte⟧{天狗|てんぐ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いける：06957_ikeru⟧。
examples.english: Just because you got a good score on the test doesn't mean you should get conceited.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{褒|ほ}められた→褒める：01204_homeru⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{天狗|てんぐ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people get a big head just from being praised a little.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
- Appearance: a red face and a very long nose ({大天狗|だいてんぐ}), or a crow's beak and wings (⟦{烏天狗|からすてんぐ}→烏天狗：31558_karasutengu⟧); the dress of a mountain ascetic (⟦{山伏|やまぶし}→山伏：29920_yamabushi⟧), one-toothed ⟦{下駄|げた}→下駄：03984_geta⟧, and a feather fan ({羽団扇|はうちわ}) that raises wind.
- Folklore: tengu live in deep mountains, are masters of swordsmanship, and are said to have taught {牛若丸|うしわかまる} (the young warrior Minamoto no Yoshitsune) on {鞍馬山|くらまやま} in Kyoto. {高尾山|たかおさん} near Tokyo is another well-known tengu mountain.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {天狗|てんぐ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become conceited, get a big head (sense 2 almost always appears in this pattern)
- {天狗|てんぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧ / へし{折|お}る: to take a conceited person down a peg
- ⟦{鼻|はな}が{高|たか}い→鼻が高い：10096_hanagatakai⟧: to be proud (of something); the long nose is why the tengu stands for pride
